title: Automating AI-Powered Podcasts: A Collaboration Call
html:
Automating AI-Powered Podcasts: A Collaboration Call

I am exploring the possibility of automating the creation of AI-powered podcasts by combining different (no or low-cost) services.

My goal is to create a somewhat streamlined workflow that integrates tools like:

  • AI Podcast Generators: To generate scripts and content outlines from existing content.
  • Text-to-Speech engines: To convert scripts into natural-sounding audio.
  • Music libraries: To provide royalty-free background music.
  • Podcast editing software: To add intros, outros, and transitions.

The below image gives you a concrete idea of what I am thinking about including some of the possible tools or services.

Personal drawing of streamlining AI-powered podcasts

This approach would enable someone to create podcasts without the need for extensive technical skills or (significant) financial investment.

Why this matters:

By automating podcast creation, one could make content more accessible to a wider audience. Podcasts offer a unique format for consuming information, allowing listeners to multitask while engaging with content. This accessibility can benefit individuals with visual impairments, those who prefer auditory learning, and those who simply find it easier to consume information through listening.

I am looking for collaborators who are passionate about AI, podcasting, or no-code solutions. If you have experience with any of these tools or are interested in exploring this project together, please reach out. Share your thoughts and expertise on my LinkedIn Newsletter copy.

Let’s discuss how we can leverage the power of AI to make podcasting more accessible and efficient.

Andrej

teaser: A call for collaboration on automating AI-powered podcasts by combining low- or no-cost generators, text-to-speech, music and editing tools.
